agents.name: Atomic Agent
agents.summary: Local-first terminal agent with llama.cpp-oriented inference and explicit engineering for small quantized models.

evidence.note: README describes the agent as local-first and says llama.cpp is used so small quantized models remain useful on consumer hardware.

agents.name: hax
agents.summary: Minimal C terminal coding agent whose low memory footprint leaves more resources available for local inference.

evidence.note: README calls local models first-class, documents llama.cpp and Ollama, and emphasizes a very small agent memory footprint.

agents.name: Nanocoder
agents.summary: Community-built local-first coding agent supporting local models through Ollama plus OpenAI-compatible APIs.

evidence.note: README describes Nanocoder as local-first and documents Ollama as a local model provider.

agents.name: Swival
agents.summary: Coding agent designed to give smaller and local models careful context management and a consistent agent workflow.

evidence.note: README explicitly states that smaller models receive the same attention as large models.
Provider documentation covers llama.cpp and generic local OpenAI-compatible servers including Ollama, vLLM and LocalAI.

agents.name: goose
agents.summary: Rust agent with CLI support, an Ollama provider, local inference options, and tooling to improve compatibility with weaker tool-calling models.

evidence.note: README documents a full CLI and Ollama provider support.
Tool-shim guide addresses locally hosted models that do not natively produce reliable tool calls.

agents.name: agentty
agents.summary: Native C++ terminal agent with local Ollama support, local retrieval, and aggressive context reduction.

evidence.note: README documents fully local Ollama models, local retrieval, and reduced repository context.

agents.name: Aider
agents.summary: Mature terminal pair-programming agent with documented Ollama and local OpenAI-compatible model support.

evidence.note: Aider documentation explicitly supports local models through Ollama and local OpenAI-compatible APIs.

agents.name: Tau
agents.summary: Small readable terminal coding-agent harness with local providers through llama.cpp and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

evidence.note: Provider guide documents local OpenAI-compatible endpoints including llama.cpp and Ollama.

agents.name: Forge
agents.summary: Provider-agnostic TypeScript coding harness with local endpoint model discovery for llama.cpp, LM Studio, vLLM and Ollama.

evidence.note: Provider implementation explicitly discovers models from llama.cpp, LM Studio, vLLM and Ollama endpoints.

agents.name: OliveCode
agents.summary: OpenCode-derived terminal coding agent with local Ollama model selection, approximate hardware-fit guidance, and optional multi-model reviews.

evidence.note: Project README documents local Ollama models, a terminal coding workflow, optional Assist reviews, and cloud/tool privacy limits.
Released source inspects the Ollama runtime and installed model capabilities; this is compatibility evidence, not small-model benchmark evidence.
